_comment: Accepted production uses of ComputedStyle::default(). Entries may only LEAVE this list; adding one is a regression and CI fails. Format: [path, line, text]; matched by path+text and count (the line is informational, it drifts with every macOS sync). lib.rs `check_animation_frame` (macOS upstream, the animation fast-path validator): builds a throwaway style only to set ONE transform value and ask effective_transform().is_identity(); no other field is read, so the derived Default's disagreement with new() cannot reach it. Entered 2026-11-09 with the S1-S20 syncs; same line exists on macOS develop.
